thread:
Maya: Customer asks for a 300ms p95 latency add-on for SMB. Want clear price + monthly cap. What do we need to ship to offer this safely?

Jonas: Technically: tenant-warm pools, KV cache pinning, and per-tenant batching limits. Also lock model variant to avoid quantization tail issues.

Priya: Observability: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 histograms, synthetic probes from customer region, request tracing. Need an automated rollback trigger.

Evan: Recommend soft launch: credits-on-miss first. Easier for ops/legal.

Grace: Commercial: pilot price idea $5k/mo + overage cap. Offer 10-20% for annual. Customer prefers flat fee vs pure per-token.

billing-bot: capacity sketch for single SMB pilot: GPU ~90 hrs/mo, ops ~25 hrs/mo, infra bump ~$1k -> rough cost $13k/mo. Split across 3 pilots => ~$4.3k base before margin.

Maya: Proposed launch criteria?

Priya: 14-day rolling p95 <=300ms for >=95% queries; synthetic probe pass >=99%; auto-rollback on sustained breach (>5m) and runbook + SLA doc.

Jonas: Risk notes: cache eviction, warm pool cold starts on bursts, and model-variant mismatch. Need canary fallback to best-effort gen.

Evan: Phases: 0) telemetry & probes (1w) 1) soft SLA & pilot pricing (2-3w) 2) reserved capacity + financial SLA (4-6w).

Grace: Action items: I'll draft price table + sample term sheet. Jonas: infra spec & hours. Priya: alerts/dashboard. Evan: rollout copy. Sync Wed 10am.
